00047 void BinaryAddUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw() 
00048 { 
00049     const int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize(); 
00050     float* const outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData(); 
00051     const float* const leftOperandSamples = inputs[LeftOperand].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel); 
00052     const float* const rightOperandSamples = inputs[RightOperand].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel); 
00053     VFP::add(leftOperandSamples, rightOperandSamples, outputSamples, numSamplesToProcess);
00054 }
